resources.name: Catlow-type empirical pair potentials for LiF and CaF2

access.notes: Born–Mayer repulsion + van der Waals parameters from Catlow et al. (J. Phys. C: Solid State Phys. 10, 1395 (1977) and J. Phys. C: Solid State Phys. 10, 1627 (1977)).

resources.notes: Needed for all stages: short‑range interactions for Li⁺–F⁻, Ca²⁺–F⁻, F⁻–F⁻, and cation‑cation Coulomb only.

resources.name: CaF2 lattice constant

access.notes: National Bureau of Standards (U.S.), Monograph 25, vol. 21, 1984, p. 52. a0 = 5.46305 Å.

resources.notes: Used to build the slab model.
